remarks: Experience quintessential coastal living in the heart of Summerland. This beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 1-bath cottage pairs effortless beachside style with sweeping ocean views and the added benefit of short-term rental potential--an exceptional opportunity for a full-time residence, weekend escape, or vacation home investment. Thoughtfully updated throughout, the home blends relaxed coastal charm with playful vintage-inspired details. Ocean views take center stage from the living room, kitchen, and expansive front decks, creating a seamless connection to the Pacific beyond.
